name: lijigang/ljg-skill-xray-paper
description: A paper X-ray skill that analyses a research paper into problem, perspective, and result plus cognitive delta cards in ASCII art, giving a fast structured read of an arXiv paper, paper URL, or PDF path.
install: claude plugin add lijigang/ljg-skill-xray-paper, invoked as /ljg-xray-paper <arxiv ID, paper URL, or PDF path>
